 Jen Affleck, a star of Hulu’s “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives,” reportedly filed for divorce from Zac Affleck after seven years of marriage.
 Zac says he will “always be Jen’s supporter” and wished her well, in a statement to People. 
 p]:text-cms-story-body-color-text" data-subscriber-content> Zac Affleck has spoken out after his wife and “ The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives ” star Jen Affleck filed for divorce this week.
 The reality TV star said he will “always be Jen’s supporter” in a Thursday statement to People . “Hope she is happy in this next phase of life,” he added. “Just focusing on my kids and figuring out what’s next for me.” The couple share three children and Jen is pregnant with their fourth. 
 The MomTok influencer–turned–reality TV star reportedly filed a petition for divorce Tuesday in a Provo, Utah, court, according to numerous outlets . Jen has also reportedly submitted a proposed parenting plan for their children. 
 Advertisement The “Mormon Wives” couple have been married since 2019, after meeting the year before on a Mormon dating app called Mutual when Jen was 18 and Zac was 21. Their three children were born in 2021, 2023 and 2025.

 Sept. 15, 2026 In June, Jen shared on Instagram that she and Zac were expecting their fourth child together. She also shared a photo of a strip of sonogram images Thursday on her Instagram Stories. Jen first rose to internet fame through sharing content around her pregnancy on social media. 
 Jen and Zac also shared separate photos celebrating their daughter Nora’s 5th birthday on each of their Instagram Stories on Wednesday.
 Advertisement Zac is reportedly “doing okay” following Jen’s filing, according to People sources. The outlet reported Wednesday that “He and Jen are staying focused on preparing for the baby and supporting their kids.”
 Rocky moments of Jen and Zac’s marriage have been depicted on “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives.” The couple briefly separated in 2025 after the first season of the reality show had aired, but later reconciled. In August, Jen told the outlet that she and Zac were working on their relationship “behind closed doors” but credited him for helping her get through her first trimester. 
 Jen, who competed on Season 34 of “Dancing With the Stars” last year, will appear next in “The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County.” The first “Mormon Wives” spinoff will premiere Nov. 12 on Hulu.
